criteria.name: Non-text content
criteria.evidence: axe: the icon is named through aria-labelledby from a11y_buttonActionMessage on all 6 stories

criteria.name: Contrast (minimum)
criteria.evidence: source: no text, only an icon

criteria.name: Reflow
criteria.evidence: screenshots and scroll width at 1280, 390 and 320: no horizontal scroll

criteria.name: Non-text contrast
criteria.evidence: computed: the icon fill is #999999 on white, 2.85:1; 3:1 needed for the only visible part of the control
criteria.note: Heal (a11y): default icon colour to a grey of 3:1 or more (for example the text secondary token).

criteria.name: Keyboard
criteria.evidence: Keyboard story (play): Tab focuses the button by its name, Enter and Space each call onClick

criteria.name: Focus visible
criteria.evidence: keyboard run: 2px #000 outline with a 2px white ring on Tab

criteria.name: Focus not obscured (minimum)
criteria.evidence: screenshots: nothing in the component covers the focused button

criteria.name: Consistent help
criteria.evidence: page level: the component offers no help mechanism

criteria.name: Redundant entry
criteria.evidence: flow level: the component asks for no data

criteria.name: Accessible authentication (minimum)
criteria.evidence: flow level: the component is not part of a login step

criteria.name: Name, role, value
criteria.evidence: axe button-name passes on all 6 stories; disabled uses the native attribute
